3	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
4	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailNormalizer;
5	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneNormalizer;
6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
7	
8	/**
9	 * Derives the owner-identity values matching keys off: the owner's {@code memberId} and the single
10	 * {@code identityKey} that all duplicate detection is expressed through. The identity key is the SHA-256 of the
11	 * owner's normalized telephone, email and last-name Soundex (see {@link SoundexResolver}). Keeping this
12	 * here (rather than in {@link OwnerMapper} or the REST controller) mirrors {@link HouseholdResolver},
13	 * {@link LocalityResolver} and {@link MembershipLevelResolver} and gives owner-identity derivation a single home.
14	 * Unlike the static utilities it collaborates with the field normalizers, so it is a Spring component.
15	 */
16	@Component
17	public class IdentityKeyResolver {
18	
19	    /**
20	     * The fixed version tag mixed into every derived owner identifier by the version-2 owner identity. It is folded into
21	     * the region segment of the {@code memberId} and into the hashed input of the {@code memberId}'s HASH8 segment and
22	     * the {@code identityKey} (and, sharing this same tag, the {@code householdId}; see
23	     * {@link HouseholdResolver#deriveHouseholdId}), so every identifier changes and no value produced under version 1 is
24	     * produced again. It is deliberately absent from the user-facing {@code locality} (see
25	     * {@link LocalityResolver#deriveLocality}), which stays the plain region code.
26	     */
27	    public static final String VERSION_TAG = "V2";
28	
29	    private final TelephoneNormalizer telephoneNormalizer;
30	
31	    private final EmailNormalizer emailNormalizer;
32	
33	    public IdentityKeyResolver(TelephoneNormalizer telephoneNormalizer,
34	                               EmailNormalizer emailNormalizer) {
35	        this.telephoneNormalizer = telephoneNormalizer;
36	        this.emailNormalizer = emailNormalizer;
37	    }
38	
39	    /**
40	     * Derives the owner's {@code identityKey}, the single value all duplicate detection is expressed through. It is the
41	     * full lower-case SHA-256 hex digest (64 characters) of
42	     * {@code <VERSION_TAG>|<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>}, mixing in the fixed version-2
43	     * {@link #VERSION_TAG} and joining the canonical E.164 telephone (see {@link TelephoneNormalizer#canonicalize}), the
44	     * normalized email (see {@link EmailNormalizer#normalize}, empty when the owner has none) and the American Soundex of
45	     * the owner's last name (see {@link SoundexResolver#soundex}). Because the telephone is part of the key, two owners that differ only
46	     * in telephone — such as two members of the same household — have different keys; only owners whose whole key
47	     * matches are duplicates.
48	     *
49	     * @param owner the owner whose identity key should be derived
50	     * @return the owner's identity key
51	     */
52	    public String deriveIdentityKey(Owner owner) {
53	        String telephone = telephoneNormalizer.canonicalize(owner.getTelephone());
54	        String email = emailNormalizer.normalize(owner.getEmail());
55	        String lowerEmail = (email == null || email.isBlank()) ? "" : email.toLowerCase();
56	        String lastNameSoundex = SoundexResolver.soundex(owner.getLastName());
57	        return HexDigest.lowerHex(VERSION_TAG + "|" + telephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + lastNameSoundex);
58	    }
59	
60	    /**
61	     * Derives an owner's {@code memberId}, the single unified identifier formatted
62	     * {@code <REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>}. {@code REGION} is the version-2 region segment: the region code derived from the
63	     * owner's postcode (see {@link Region#forPostcode}, falling back to {@link LocalityResolver#UNKNOWN} when the
64	     * postcode maps to no known region) with the fixed {@link #VERSION_TAG} mixed in; {@code FY} is the two-digit
65	     * fiscal-year segment of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date
66	     * (see {@link FiscalYearResolver#fiscalYearSuffix}); {@code HASH8} is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
67	     * SHA-256 digest of the {@link #VERSION_TAG}, the normalized telephone (see {@link TelephoneNormalizer#canonicalize})
68	     * and the owner's last name; and {@code CHK} is a single Luhn check digit (see {@link CheckDigitResolver#deriveCheckDigit})
69	     * computed over the digits of {@code <REGION><FY><HASH8>} (e.g. {@code NSWV2271A2B3C4D9}). Being a pure function of the
70	     * postcode, registration date, telephone and last name it carries no sequence number and is stable for a given owner.
71	     *
72	     * @param owner the newly mapped owner about to be saved, with its telephone already normalized and its registration
73	     *              date resolved
74	     * @return the generated member id
75	     */
76	    public String deriveMemberId(Owner owner) {
77	        String base = regionCode(owner) + FiscalYearResolver.fiscalYearSuffix(owner.getRegistrationDate())
78	            + hash8(owner);
79	        return base + CheckDigitResolver.deriveCheckDigit(base);
80	    }
81	
82	    /**
83	     * Returns the version-2 {@code REGION} segment of the owner's identifier: the owner's plain region code (see
84	     * {@link LocalityResolver#regionCode}, derived from the owner's postcode, {@link LocalityResolver#UNKNOWN} when it
85	     * maps to no known region) with the fixed {@link #VERSION_TAG} mixed in. Factored out of {@link #deriveMemberId} so
86	     * the region segment has a single home, shared by every identifier the owner's region prefixes. The plain region code
87	     * (without the version tag) remains the owner's user-facing {@code locality} (see
88	     * {@link LocalityResolver#deriveLocality}), so the two are deliberately kept distinct.
89	     *
90	     * @param owner the owner whose region segment should be derived
91	     * @return the version-2 region segment, the plain region code (or {@link LocalityResolver#UNKNOWN}) with the version
92	     * tag mixed in
93	     */
94	    private String regionCode(Owner owner) {
95	        return LocalityResolver.regionCode(owner.getPostcode()) + VERSION_TAG;
96	    }
97	
98	    /**
99	     * Returns the version-2 {@code HASH8} segment of the owner's identifier: the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
100	     * SHA-256 digest (see {@link HexDigest#upperHexPrefix}) of the fixed {@link #VERSION_TAG}, the owner's canonical
101	     * telephone (see {@link TelephoneNormalizer#canonicalize}) and the owner's last name. Factored out of
102	     * {@link #deriveMemberId} so the hash segment has a single home, shared by every identifier the owner's hash
103	     * contributes to.
104	     *
105	     * @param owner the owner whose hash segment should be derived, with its telephone already normalized
106	     * @return the 8-character upper-case hash segment
107	     */
108	    private String hash8(Owner owner) {
109	        String telephone = telephoneNormalizer.canonicalize(owner.getTelephone());
110	        return HexDigest.upperHexPrefix(VERSION_TAG + telephone + owner.getLastName(), 8);
111	    }
112	}
